provenance.rendering: Platform.OS is android. CaptureScreen renders under react-test-renderer with the real core store; timers are fake and each step advances them 1 s, so the copilot's 800 ms wait ends. The AI key is stored and required; createAIProvider answers from the scenario's suggestions.
